title: The Minus Mod
description: Adding YOUR dumb ideas to this block game
body:
# The Minus Mod
This mod adds many suggestions from a Roblox Short I made. 'Twas chaos.
This Mod has been rebranded to The Minus Mod.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/CIc9-gN8M7A" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Additions
- Toaster: The toaster can toast Bread, Toasted Bread, and Burnt Bread. This allows new food to be made and for Ash to be created, to create Gunpowder. Don't stick a fork in it. Or water 
- Water Bar: Both a salad bar-esque structure and a water version of the End Rod. The structures contain Water That Probably Should Not Exist that physically replaces blocks and Bubbles that make you float.
- Player Identifier Block: A new redstone block that can detect if a Player is in front of it. Requires a redstone update to work.
- Ant Named Jeff: Ants can now spawn around the world. If you kill them (which, why would you?), you can craft Ant Block, Pillars, Slabs, Stairs, and Walls.
- Stamina: Using a gamerule, you can now breathe worse.
- Butter: Slippery butter can be placed down to slide across, or be made into Buttered Butter to slide more. Buttered Breads also exist. The butter can also be turned into...
- Cheese, Cheese Curds, and Cheese Puffs: A New food source that can get you the effect "Cheese Dusty" (exclusive to Cheese Puffs), which makes some things slightly harder.

All of this can be found in a special creative inventory tab.
